signIn.title: Your family's insurance, in one place
signIn.intro: Sign in to keep your family's cover, documents and plan safe and in sync.
signIn.guestNote: We keep your family on this device. You can add an account later.
signIn.localMode: Local mode: sign-in is switched off, so you'll go straight in.
signIn.invitedAs: You'll join as {name}. You'll see your cover and the hospital button.
signIn.inviteGone: This invite has expired or was already used. Ask for a new link.

consent.title: Before we start
consent.intro: Kavach keeps your family's details to give you advice. Choose what we may use.

planning.label: Use my family, money and policy details to plan cover
planning.hint: Needed to show your family's cover.

health.label: Health details (for example, diabetes)
health.hint: Optional. Helps at the hospital. Without it, hospital advice may be less precise.

consent.required: Kavach needs at least the first one to work.
consent.promise: We never sell your data. We never contact insurers for you. You can download or delete everything at any time from Settings.

family.title: Tell us about your family
family.intro: Who depends on you? One sentence is enough.
family.label: Your family, in your words
family.placeholder: I'm Rahul, 34, in Bengaluru. Wife Priya, daughter Anaya is 5, and my parents live with us…
family.example: Me, my wife Priya, daughter Anaya, and my parents in Pune
family.listening: Listening… let go when you're done
family.micBlocked: We couldn't use the microphone. Please type instead.
family.voiceReady: Voice note recorded ({seconds} s). Continue to send it.
family.found: Found {count, plural, one {# person} other {# people}}
family.nobody: I couldn't find anyone in that. Could you say who lives with you?

confirm.title: Is this your family?
confirm.intro: Tap anyone to change their details.
confirm.needAges: Fill in {count, plural, one {# detail} other {# details}} to continue

edit.title: Edit person
edit.name: Name
edit.conditionsHint: Only kept because you allowed health details.

money.title: Four numbers. Rough is fine.
money.intro: Why we ask: to suggest only what you can afford.
money.fund: Savings you could use in an emergency
money.emiHigh: That's a lot of your income. We'll keep the plan lean.
money.incomeHint: Used to size life cover. Leave empty to use take-home × 12.
